purpose: Spend the expiring free 3D balance while producing Moonberry Production Pack v1 first, then reusable shared/activity kits, then future-region hero seeds.

planning_credit_envelope.note: Live balance and actual provider usage are authoritative. Recompute the final stage as charges vary.

burn_stages.name: MOONBERRY_PRODUCTION_PACK_V1
burn_stages.goal: One coherent W01 exterior production pack that can be assembled immediately.

burn_stages.name: ACTIVITY_SOCIAL_INTERIOR_SUPPORT_KIT
burn_stages.goal: Reusable assets supporting fishing, gardening, cooking, crafting, photography, social spaces and light home/interior use.

burn_stages.name: FUTURE_REGION_HERO_SEED_PACK
burn_stages.goal: Distinctive landmarks for W02-W08 without fully committing each map.

burn_stages.name: FINAL_BURN_RECOVERY_VARIANTS
burn_stages.goal: Hero recovery, missing high-reuse kit, or useful variants; consume remaining free balance safely before expiry.

full_balance_use_policy: Use essentially all free credits if approved useful assets remain; do not generate invisible micro-props merely to hit zero.
billable_gate: H0+H1+H2+H3 required; 150 slots are not 150 automatic paid calls
